summary: The diff implements decodeURIComponent per the pinned spec. It does ToString on the argument, then Decode with an empty preserveEscapeSet, and follows the Decode steps in order: strLen, the k+2 >= strLen check before the hex check, B and k+=2, leading-ones n, the n=0 ASCII branch (preserve-set branch kept though unreachable with an empty set), the n==1 or n>4 check, the k+3(n-1) bounds check, the continuation loop (% check, hex check, append, j++), UTF-8 validation via from_utf8 (rejects overlong, surrogate and >U+10FFFF), and UTF-16 encoding of the code point. Every throw is a URIError and nothing is swallowed. No test-shaped branches, no made-up values, no unrelated edits (the _this/_new_target rename is only the unused-parameter cleanup). The two timeouts (S15.1.3.2_A2.5_T1 sloppy/strict) look like performance on a large loop, not a spec deviation. Minor nits only: a redundant `let Some(&c) = units.get(k) else { break; }` and a redundant `text.chars().next()` check. Neither changes behaviour.
